profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Ruby on Rails | Codebase Longevity & Internal Tooling
profile.summary: Senior backend engineer with 10+ years of experience specializing in Ruby on Rails monoliths. Throughout my career, I've worked with legacy codebases of all sizes. I especially enjoy digging into tricky bugs in code that no one remembers writing. I also love developing internal tools to help users improve their day-to-day workflow or get their daily tasks done more efficiently.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend Ruby on Rails development on the core platform team handling money movement logistics, integration with accounting software, and development of internal accounting tools.

positions.title: Independent Author & Publisher
positions.description: Took two years off from engineering to pursue writing full-time and start a self-publishing business from the ground up. Handled the full publishing process for three novels, several short stories, and a weekly web serial, including market research, formatting, production, and digital/print distribution. Built a small reader base and managed marketing emails and email automations, as well as reader engagement.
